invariants.rationale: The method always returns the 'map' object, which is always instantiated before any return.
Parameter tmxFile is required to determine the file being loaded and is used throughout the method.
imageResolver is passed to multiple helper methods; its non-nullness avoids errors during tileset loading.
The getProperties() method is called and populated in all method paths.
The getLayers() method is used in the parallax code, which would fail if layers was null.
